lines.zh: 我迈步的时候，身体会晃
lines.en: My body wobbles as I take a step.

lines.zh: 绿色的块状身子压过地面
lines.en: My green blocky body presses over the ground.
My foot lifts a thread of slime.
Wet marks are left where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的手臂摆动得有点笨
lines.en: My arms swing a little clumsily.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪在史莱姆区块里
lines.en: I move step by step through the slime chunk.
A small piece of me drops off now and then.

lines.zh: 掉了的那块，慢慢又长回来
lines.en: The missing bit slowly grows back.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，怕稀释自己
lines.en: I go around puddles so I don't thin out.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，但没声音
lines.en: My steps are heavy, but silent.
I walk slowly. The slime is too sticky.
I move along the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，把脚从泥里拔出来
lines.en: I pause and pull my foot out of the mud.
Then I shuffle on.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上还在一鼓一鼓
lines.en: I stand, and my body keeps pulsing.

lines.zh: 黏液从我的边角往下滴
lines.en: Slime drips from my edges.

lines.zh: 我在听地下有没有动静
lines.en: I listen for movement underground.

lines.zh: 这片区块的石头是湿的
lines.en: The stone in this chunk is damp.
My shape isn't quite fixed.

lines.zh: 我在慢慢把自己收拢一点
lines.en: I slowly draw myself in.
The cave air is close.
I rest my arms against my sides.

lines.zh: 有水滴落在我头上，滑下去
lines.en: A drop lands on my head and slides off.
I count the dripping sounds.
Waiting for something to come in.
My body grows heavier.
Standing long enough glues me down.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，泥土跟着起了一层
lines.en: I lift a foot and dirt comes up with it.

lines.zh: 我转过头，绿色的脸上没有表情
lines.en: I turn my head; my green face shows nothing.

lines.zh: 你站在我的地下通道里
lines.en: You're standing in my underground passage.
My body is wider than yours.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我看见你了
lines.en: I have no eyes, but I see you.
I raise an arm slowly.

lines.zh: 黏液从我的指间垂下去
lines.en: Slime hangs from between my fingers.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，踩到了湿的地方
lines.en: You step back into something wet.
That's my trail.
This whole patch is mine.
You may leave. I won't chase.
But don't go deeper.
My kind are over that way.
A chunk is knocked off me.
That chunk slowly swells back.
My shape goes lopsided.
Slime splatters the floor.
I feel no pain, only loss.
That took a layer off me.
I slowly draw my body back in.
The harder you hit, the stickier I get.
You'd still better not come too close.
I haven't come apart yet.

lines.zh: 你手里的黏液球我认得
lines.en: I know the slimeball in your hand.
That could patch my gaps.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我慢慢走过去
lines.en: You hold it up; I shuffle over.

lines.zh: 我伸手接的时候会黏住你
lines.en: When I take it, I'll stick to you.
Don't worry. I only want repair.
I press it into the gap.
The gap slowly closes.
Any more? I'm still missing some.
Don't put it back away.
That's much better now.
You hit me and stick.
Half your hand is stuck to me.
I ease back so you can pull free.

lines.zh: 我的身体被撞得凹了一块
lines.en: The impact dents my body.

lines.zh: 凹的地方自己鼓起来了
lines.en: The dent swells back out on its own.
That didn't anger me.
I turn aside to let you pass.
A long thread of slime stretches.
It snaps back onto me.
A layer stays on your boot.
There's more than one of me in this chunk.
The large and the small keep together.
The small ones go ahead to scout.
The large ones follow behind.
We need no words.
One touch and we know.
We'd stick together.
Then keep a little apart.
The same damp patch is home.
Enough for all of us.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，慢慢把它裹起来
lines.en: I bend and slowly wrap it up.
It's wrapped into my body.
After a while it slides back out.
I can't hold small things.
You dropped it; I'll hold it for you.
I can't lift anything too heavy.

lines.zh: 黏液球粘住我了，帮我抠一下。
lines.en: A slimeball stuck to me. Pick it off?
Two shakes and it won't come off.
Then I'll carry it for now.
I'm in no hurry anyway.
You've stepped into my chunk.
I slowly square my body.
My arms come up.
This will land heavy and sticky.
You're not retreating very fast.

lines.zh: 我身上掉的碎块会绊住你
lines.en: The bits I shed will trip you.
All the stone here is wet.
Your feet will slip.
I squeeze over bit by bit.
No rush. I'm patient.
Your way out is over there.
Pity I'm in the middle.
Then I won't hold back.
Then come on ahead.
I slowly shorten the distance.
You change direction; I lean that way.

lines.zh: 我的身体把通道堵了一半
lines.en: My body blocks half the passage.
You can only take the other side.
That side is narrower yet.
I wait for you to wedge yourself.

lines.zh: 我身上的黏液滴在地上
lines.en: My slime drips onto the floor.
Every step of yours lands in it.
You're slowing down.
And I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我的手臂已经举到头边
lines.en: My arms are up at head height.
Two more steps will do.
Then now's the time.
My arms come down.
My arm falls with a wet thud.
That was sticky and heavy.
You're shoved back two steps.
My body slams into your chest.
A layer of slime coats your hands.
Your grip on the weapon slips.

lines.zh: 另一条黏手臂也举起来
lines.en: My other slime arm rises too.

lines.zh: 这一下拍在你的护肩上
lines.en: This one lands on your pauldron.
Slime runs into the seams of your armour.
You retreat, leaving a slick trail.
I press forward after you.
You needn't run so fast.
I'm not fast to begin with.
But you'll slow down eventually.

lines.zh: 我从史莱姆区块的土里鼓出来
lines.en: I swell up out of the slime chunk's earth.
First a mass of green.
Then legs and arms take shape.
I'm a size larger than the small ones.
Slime runs down off me.

lines.zh: 洞底的石头被我压出水
lines.en: The cave floor squeezes water out under me.
I steady myself and lift my head.
This place is damp. Good.
I shuffle toward the movement.
My feet stick, so I don't move fast.
But I don't need to be fast.
I only need to keep coming.
You'll tire out first.
I'll wait for that.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的表面就干了
lines.en: Heat dries my surface out.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，摊开一大片
lines.en: I hit the ground and spread wide.

lines.zh: 水把我冲散了，我凑不回来
lines.en: Water thins me out; I can't pull together.
The blast throws me into several blobs.
The arrow passes through, leaving a hole.
That light stiffens my slime.
I've gone shrivelled. I can't move.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，整团都在颤
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my whole mass shakes.
No ground. I spread apart.
